verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
Mu buyinike
-Ka tugumenga
Newankubadde nga tuli
Mu kabi kanene katya,
Tujjukirenga
Ggwe watusooka.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Bwe wanajjanga,
-Ekigambo kyonna
Ekirumya-emyoyo gyaffe
Ekimalamu amaanyi,
Yimusa-amaaso
Tukulabenga.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Tulongooseze
-Olugendo lwaffe;
Tulagirirenga-ekkubo,
Tuwe-entanda y'omu mwoyo,
N'oluvannyuma
-Otutuuse-ewuwo.
